Monitoring.trackingDescription: User ID, email aur naam se judi masked recordings aur usage analytics allow karein. Yeh preference sirf is browser par lagu hai. Zaroori error reporting enabled rahegi. Off karne par app reload ho sakti hai.
Monitoring.unavailable: Is deployment par analytics aur recordings disabled hain.
Monitoring.privacyDisclosure: Hum error diagnostics ke liye Sentry aur usage analytics aur masked session recordings ke liye Microsoft Clarity use karte hain. Diagnostics mein user ID, email, naam, business ID, subscription state aur language preferences shamil ho sakte hain. Financial details, uploaded documents aur form values shamil nahi hain. Settings mein is browser ke liye analytics aur recordings off kar sakte hain; zaroori sanitized error reporting alag hai. Browser data clear karne par preference reset hoti hai. Pehle collect ki gayi information providers ki retention aur deletion policies ke anusar rakhi jati hai.
Monitoring.metaPixelDisclosure: Aapki marketing permission ke baad selected page visits, verified signup, onboarding, cheque-count milestones, blocked free limits aur purchase starts/completions private analytics database mein record hote hain aur Meta Pixel/Conversions API se share hote hain. Meta ko hashed account ID aur verified email/phone, IP/browser info, campaign/click IDs, product, currency aur actual cash paid mil sakta hai. Cheque contents, bank/party details, images ya form contents share nahi hote. Raw events 90 din, bina identifiers ke daily totals 13 mahine aur matching/delivery payloads maximum 7 din rakhe jaate hain. Cookie settings se permission withdraw karne par future collection aur unsent events rukte hain; pehle bheja data Meta policies ke adheen hai. Explicit account erasure linked raw analytics hataata hai; sirf deactivation historical records nahi mitaata.

FAQ.description: Common questions search karein, related topics dekhein, ya problem report karein.
FAQ.noResults: Aapki search se match karta koi question nahi mila.

create_business.question: Main business kaise banaoon?
create_business.answer: Dashboard se business banane ka option choose karein aur details bharein. Phir us business ke liye accounts, parties aur cheques add karein.

manage_businesses.question: Kya main ek se zyada businesses manage kar sakta hoon?
manage_businesses.answer: Haan. Har set of records ke liye alag business banayein, phir business switcher se unke beech move karein.

add_cheque.question: Main cheque kaise add karoon?
add_cheque.answer: Cheques kholein, Add cheque choose karein aur details bharein. Save karne se pehle business, account, party, amount aur dates review karein.

scan_cheque.question: Main cheque scan kaise kar sakta hoon?
scan_cheque.answer: Scan tool kholein aur supported hone par camera ya photo library use karein. Cheque save karne se pehle extracted fields zaroor check aur correct karein.

free_plan.question: Free plan mein kya milta hai?
free_plan.answer: Free plan mein 50 tak active cheques supported hain. Available paid tools aur limits Features page par listed hain.

plans_payment.question: Plans aur payments kahan dekh sakta hoon?
plans_payment.answer: Available plans aur add-ons review karne ke liye Features kholein. Purchases aur access aapke signed-in account se linked hote hain.

reminders.question: Cheque reminders kab milenge?
reminders.answer: Reminders aapke account mein configured due dates aur notification preferences ke hisaab se aate hain. Agar reminder expected na ho to notification settings check karein.

notification_settings.question: Notification settings kaise badloon?
notification_settings.answer: Apne account ki reminder preferences dekhne ke liye Settings kholein aur Notifications choose karein.

data_privacy.question: Mera cheque data kaise protected hai?
data_privacy.answer: Aapke cheque records aapke signed-in account ke hain aur public website par show nahi hote. Support messages mein passwords ya sensitive account details share na karein.

secure_account.question: Main apna account secure kaise karoon?
secure_account.answer: Strong sign-in method use karein, device protected rakhein aur verification codes share na karein. Available hone par Settings → Security mein app PIN bhi set kar sakte hain.

Settings.privacyIntroContent: ChequeCheck par aapka swagat hai. Hum aapki privacy ki value karte hain aur aapke personal data ko protect karne ke liye committed hain. Yeh Privacy Policy batati hai ki hum aapka data kaise collect aur use karte hain.
Settings.privacyDataCollectContent: Hum woh information collect karte hain jo aap hamein directly dete hain, jaise aapka naam, email address, aur business details. Hum aapke cheques, accounts, aur parties se juda data bhi collect karte hain.
Settings.privacyHowUseContent: Aapka data sirf ChequeCheck service provide karne aur use improve karne ke liye use hota hai. Hum aapka personal data kisi third party ko bechte nahi hain.
Settings.privacyDataSecurityContent: Hum aapke data ko protect karne ke liye industry-standard security measures use karte hain. Aapki information Supabase mein securely store ki jati hai.
Settings.privacyYourRightsContent: Aapke paas apne data ko access, correct ya delete karne ka pura right hai. Aap apni information app settings mein manage kar sakte hain.
Settings.privacyContactUsContent: Agar aapko is Privacy Policy ke baare mein koi sawaal hai, toh hamein support@chequecheck.com par contact karein.
Settings.refundSubRefundsContent: Hum naye subscriptions par 7-day money-back guarantee dete hain. Agar aap ChequeCheck se satisfied nahi hain, toh 7 din ke andar refund request kar sakte hain.
Settings.refundHowRequestContent: Refund request karne ke liye, hamein apne account details ke saath support@chequecheck.com par email karein. Hum 5-10 business days mein refund process karte hain.
Settings.refundExceptionsContent: Monthly renewals ke liye refunds available nahi hain jab tak ki charge ke 24 hours ke andar request na ki jaye. Hum partial refunds nahi dete.
Settings.refundTrialPeriodsContent: Naye users free trial period ke liye eligible ho sakte hain. Trial period mein koi charges nahi lagenge aur aap kabhi bhi cancel kar sakte hain.
Settings.termsAcceptanceContent: ChequeCheck use karke aap in Terms and Conditions se bandhe hue hain. Agar aap in terms se sehmat nahi hain, toh aap app use nahi kar sakte.
Settings.termsUseLicenseContent: Hum aapko ChequeCheck use karne ka personal license dete hain. Aap app ko reverse engineer ya source code extract karne ki koshish nahi kar sakte.
Settings.termsAccountRespContent: Apne account aur password ki confidentiality maintain karne ki responsibility aapki hai. Aapke account se hone wali sabhi activities ke liye aap responsible honge.
Settings.termsLiabilityContent: ChequeCheck "as is" provide kiya jata hai. Hum kisi bhi indirect ya consequential damages ke liye liable nahi honge.
Settings.termsChangesToTermsContent: Hum kisi bhi waqt in terms ko modify kar sakte hain. Bade badlavon ki notification hum app ke andar denge.

Settings.releaseDraftsDesc: Adhuri entries ko drafts mein save karein aur jab taiyar hon, global search se dhoondh kar continue karein.

Settings.releasePremiumDesc: Premium ke saath cheques aur parties import karein, cheque templates aur saved filters reuse karein, aur ek saath kai cheques ka status update karein.
Settings.releaseRemindersDesc: Cheque add ya update karte waqt party ko SMS bhejna hai ya nahi, chunein. Voice reminders set karein aur voice credits se sample call try karein.

cookieConsent.title: Optional marketing cookies
cookieConsent.description: Cheque Check par optional marketing analytics allow karein? Selected visits, signup, onboarding, cheque-count milestones, free-limit blocks aur purchases record karke ads measure karne ke liye Meta Pixel/Conversions API se share hote hain. Meta ko hashed account/contact IDs, browser/IP info, ad IDs aur purchase product/value mil sakta hai. Cheque contents, bank/party details, images ya form entries share nahi hote. Cookie settings mein kabhi bhi reject ya withdraw karein. Retention aur data rights ke liye privacy policy dekhein.

problems.accountsTitle: Kaunse bank mein kitna rakhna hai?
problems.accountsDescription: Alag accounts, alag cheques. Kis account se payment hai, baar-baar check karna padta hai.
problems.recordsTitle: Thoda diary mein. Thoda WhatsApp par.
problems.recordsDescription: Party ka naam, amount aur cheque number dhoondhne ke liye poora register palatna padta hai.

landing.problemClose: Aap business sambhaliye. Cheques ka record ek jagah rakhiye.
landing.howDescription: Bhaari accounting software nahi. Aapke roz ke cheque kaam ka saathi.
landing.remindersDescription: Cheque ki date ke liye phone-call reminder set karein, taaki funds aur deposit ki planning mein madad mile. Calls ke liye settings, eligibility aur available credits zaroori hain; delivery service availability par depend karti hai.
landing.reminderExampleDescription: Suniye cheque reminder phone call ka ek example.
landing.pricingDescription: Pehle apne cheques organize karein. Paid features ki zaroorat ho, toh current plans aur prices dekh lein.
landing.pricingNote: Paid features aur usage credits ke liye current catalogue dekhein.

faq.accountingQuestion: Kya yeh Tally ya accounting software hai?
faq.accountingAnswer: Nahi. Cheque Check cheques ka record, dates, parties aur bank accounts organize karne ka saathi hai. Yeh aapke accounting software ki jagah nahi leta.
faq.bankQuestion: Kya mera bank account connect karna padega?
faq.bankAnswer: Nahi. Aap bank account ka record aur cheque details khud add karte hain. Yeh bank balance sync ya payment transfer karne ka app nahi hai.
faq.remindersAnswer: Phone-call reminders set kar sakte hain. Calls ke liye settings, eligibility aur available call credits zaroori hain; delivery service availability par depend karti hai. App mein reminder inbox bhi hai, aur supported device par permission dekar push notifications on kar sakte hain.
faq.scanQuestion: Kya har cheque ko scan karna zaroori hai?
faq.scanAnswer: Nahi. Details manually bhar sakte hain. Optional AI scan ke liye available scan credits zaroori hain. Scan ke baad details check karke hi save karein.
faq.bounceQuestion: Kya cheque bounce hone se guarantee ke saath bachaata hai?
faq.bounceAnswer: Nahi. Records aur reminders planning mein madad karte hain, lekin funds arrange karna, cheque deposit karna aur status update karna aapki zimmedaari hai. App bank clearance verify nahi karta.
faq.mobileQuestion: Kya phone par use kar sakta hoon?
faq.mobileAnswer: Haan. Phone ke browser mein Cheque Check kholkar use karein. Hindi, Hinglish aur English mein se apni bhasha chun sakte hain.

features.title: Features
features.description: Aapke business ki cheque activity record aur review karne ke tools.
features.cheques: Optional AI cheque scan se details extract karne mein madad paayein, ya manually entry karein. Scan credits zaroori hain; details check karke save karein.
features.accounts: Cheque activity ko bank account ke hisaab se organize karein.
features.parties: Customer, supplier aur vendor records ek jagah rakhein.
features.reminders: Cheque dates ke phone-call reminders set karein. Settings, eligibility, available call credits aur service availability laagu hain.
features.reports: Premium access ke saath cheque records ki PDF aur Excel reports download karein.

comparison.offer: Launch offer: pehle 100 naye users ko 3 mahine ka Premium manually diya ja sakta hai. Existing users eligible nahi hain. AI-scan aur call credits included nahi hain. Signup se yeh offer automatic activate nahi hota; eligibility ke liye support se confirm karein.
